fact: ANPTIC says the administration has used for several years its SIGED document-management platform, which ANPTIC developed, and ANPTIC's Direction des Systemes et Applications drafted the functional analysis for its redesign on 14 October 2025, with the firm Digital Cogito supporting.
title: Gestion electronique du courrier : un pas de plus vers la modernisation avec la refonte du SIGED
publisher: Agence Nationale de Promotion des TIC (ANPTIC)
